conditions.blocker: no paper session has produced a sufficient supervised result
conditions.description: A supervised paper session has run long enough, on wall-clock time, to be evidence rather than a smoke test.
The paper session reconciles with no errors.
The owner has stated, explicitly, how much money may be at risk. An agent cannot infer or assume this.
conditions.required: a positive amount stated by the owner

conditions.description: The venue and the legal jurisdiction it will be traded from are confirmed by a human.

conditions.blocker: loss limits are not fully configured
conditions.description: Per-trade, daily and total loss limits are configured.

conditions.blocker: no confirmed secure credential delivery mechanism
conditions.description: A secure mechanism exists for delivering venue credentials directly to the execution host. No key, seed phrase or wallet is ever requested, printed or stored by this tooling.

notes: Clearing every condition still does not authorise real money: it only means a human may now make that decision deliberately.
Four of the six conditions are human decisions by construction and cannot be satisfied by any amount of further engineering.
